description.value:
Every sentinel bonds with their blade, but those who follow the Path of the Forceblade take that bond further, weaving the Force through the weapon itself until it responds to thought as readily as to hand.

Their blade becomes an extension of will as much as arm, flying to their grip, striking on their behalf, and returning true even when thrown across a battlefield. Few weapons feel more alive than one wielded by a Forceblade adept.
